# React TypeScript Tailwind Starter
> A modern, production-grade template built with React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, DaisyUI, Vite, and build-time static HTML prerendering for optimal SEO and LLM ingestion.

React TypeScript Tailwind Starter (https://ts-react-tailwind-starter.vercel.app) is an open-source web application foundation designed to solve common Single Page Application (SPA) indexing and crawler visibility challenges without requiring heavy server runtimes.

## Key Architecture & Features
- **Core Framework**: React 18 with concurrent features and hydration support (`hydrateRoot`).
- **Language**: TypeScript with strict mode enabled.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v3 and DaisyUI v4 component library with customizable themes.
- **Build System**: Vite with `@vitejs/plugin-react-swc` for sub-second development builds.
- **Routing**: React Router 7 declarative routing with nested layout architecture.
- **SEO Engine**: Dynamic meta tag management via `useSEO` hook, canonical URL enforcement, Open Graph and Twitter Card generation, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data.
- **Prerender Pipeline**: Build-time static HTML generation for all declared routes (`npm run build:prerender`), enabling complete HTML content delivery to crawlers, search engines, and AI agents.
- **Bot Optimization**: AI-friendly `robots.txt` granting explicit crawler permissions (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended).

## Application Routes
- `/`: Home page with template highlights and overview.
- `/about`: Architecture details and tech stack documentation.
- `/profile`: User settings and session overview.
